title: A faint trail of smoke rises ahead
description: Could be travelers. Could be trouble. The road forks here.

onPass.narration: You scout ahead silently. A small abandoned camp; you scavenge useful supplies.

onFail.narration: You stumble in the brush; whoever was there packed up before you arrived.

choices.text: Scry the camp from a distance.

onPass.narration: Your sight pierces the smoke — a hidden cache of gold lies abandoned.

onFail.narration: The vision flickers and fades. Nothing useful gleaned.

onPass.narration: You continue along the safer path.
